title: tt-inference-server — media server
description: Application metrics for the tt-inference-server media and forge engines (the forge image runs the same server). Overview, Device and HTTP hold for every model runner; the per-domain rows below them are emitted by the runners that implement them and stay empty otherwise. model_type carries the runner name (e.g. tt-whisper).

targets.expr: (sum(rate(tt_media_server_model_inference_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", model_type=~"$runner", status!="success"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(tt_media_server_model_inference_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", model_type=~"$runner"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Stage duration p95
panels.description: One unit per panel: all three are wall-clock seconds.

panels.title: Server info
panels.description: Labels of tt_media_server_info_info: what this release is running.

panels.title: Canary state
panels.description: The canary probes the inference path itself, so this is liveness as the server sees it, not just a port being open.

targets.expr: max((tt_canary_state{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", state="dead"} == 1) * 4 or (tt_canary_state{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", state="suspect"} == 1) * 3 or (tt_canary_state{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", state="probing"} == 1) * 2 or (tt_canary_state{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", state="starting"} == 1) * 1 or (tt_canary_state{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", state="healthy"} == 1) * 0 or vector(-1))

panels.title: Device warmup duration p95 by device
Canary failures/s
panels.description: or vector(0) so a period with no failures reads zero instead of No data.

panels.title: Audio — speech to text (transcription routes, server image 0.22.0+)
STT realtime factor p50
panels.description: Audio seconds processed per wall-clock second.

panels.title: Audio ingested/s
panels.description: Seconds of input audio per second.

panels.title: No-speech probability p90
panels.description: Kept apart from the latency panels: a probability does not share an axis with seconds.

panels.title: Audio — text to speech (speecht5 runner, server image 0.22.0+)
TTS request duration p95 by response format
Input rate
panels.description: Counts per second, so one axis; output audio seconds live in their own tile.

panels.title: Image (SDXL / FLUX / z-image runners, server image 0.22.0+)
HTTP request rate by status
panels.description: Needs ENABLE_METRICS, which the chart sets when podMonitor.enabled is true.
